name: Codacy
basis: Codacy's own public pages and, for company basics only, the news sources named beside each fact
what: A cloud platform that runs code quality, security and coverage checks on repositories, with AI features that review pull requests and tools that feed its findings to coding agents.

facts.fact: Founded in 2012 by Jaime Jorge (CEO) and João Caxaria (CTO), headquartered in Lisbon.
The about page states the founding year and the founders.
facts.span: Founded in 2012 by developers Jaime Jorge and João Caxaria

facts.fact: The home page's structured data gives Lisbon as its locality.
The company states it holds SOC 2 Type 2 and is GDPR compliant.
facts.span: Codacy is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and GDPR compliant.

facts.fact: The AI features of the platform are optional and opt-in.
facts.span: Codacy AI is a set of optional features integrated into the Software

people.name: João Caxaria
people.role: Co-founder; named CTO on the AI Info page

solutions.name: AI Reviewer
solutions.what: Opt-in pull request reviewer on GitHub that combines Codacy's static analysis with a language model, reads the PR, linked Jira or Linear tickets and repository instructions, and posts a review with a verdict, a summary, test suggestions and inline comments with suggested fixes. It can run automatically on the first review of a PR or on demand (button or public API).
solutions.status: generally available on GitHub for Team and Business plans; opt-in by an admin

solutions.name: Codacy Guardrails (AI Guardrails)
solutions.what: IDE extension plus the Codacy MCP server and Codacy CLI that give a user's own coding agent Codacy's scan results so the agent fixes issues; Codacy states it is not a language model itself.
solutions.status: available; free IDE extension, central configuration on paid plans

solutions.name: Codacy MCP Server
solutions.what: MCP server for the Codacy API (npm @codacy/codacy-mcp) exposing repositories, issues, security findings, pull requests and local analysis to MCP-compatible agents.

solutions.name: Auto-configure repository
solutions.what: Paid feature in which an AI coding agent reviews a repository and applies tool and code-pattern settings in Codacy, once per repository per day.

solutions.name: Codacy Skills
solutions.what: Skills for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI that drive the Codacy CLIs.

solutions.name: Smart False Positive Triage
solutions.what: AI triage that scores issues for likely false positives and surfaces them for manual review.

solutions.name: Codacy platform (Code Quality, Security, Coverage, AI Risk Hub, AI Inventory)
solutions.what: Static analysis, SAST/SCA/secrets/IaC/DAST, coverage gates and AI-usage inventory across repositories.

stories.what: Evaluated the AI Reviewer against an existing AI code review tool and switched that tool off; Codacy says its AI reviewer is part of daily work for around 170 developers.
stories.span: Codacy's AI Reviewer is better aligned with its workflow

stories.what: Uses Codacy Guardrails with GitHub Copilot in VS Code; the agent that fixes code is Copilot, not Codacy.
stories.span: 50%+ of developers adopting AI guardrails in their daily workflow

stories.what: Uses quality gates across 800 repositories and the IDE plugin with MCP integration; no AI Reviewer usage stated.
